Thursday's PPI and Friday's CPI prints, the last major inflation

confirmed a protocol change that could let anyone transact
without ever holding ETH. Let's dive in.

Bitcoin is trading like gold again, with the Federal Reserve

but positioning around the rate path. A $100 million outflow
followed Warsh's Jackson Hole speech.

78741.subject: How to Use GPT-6 Astra, the OpenAI Model Jensen Huang Called AGI 🤖
78741.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/how-to-use-gpt-6-astra

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 400k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
Three days after OpenAI [ https://substack.com/redirect/ed4b00dc-2550-4c80-8c17-87c4c148413d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] shipped GPT-6 Astra, NVIDIA [ https://substack.com/redirect/eeac2f9b-2716-407d-99d3-d1568fb5e6a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] CEO Jensen Huang declared “AGI has arrived”, crediting Astra and the more than 100,000 NVIDIA systems it was trained on.
Of course, we cannot really take this seriously, because it’s like an oil CEO announcing that they’ve just discovered driving 😬. Researchers, commentators, and analysts also pushed back within hours, and this claim probably won’t last until the next news cycle.
But that’s not what really matters here.
The more useful number arrived three days earlier: in its September 3 evaluation, Artificial Analysis found Astra matched Claude Fable 5’s [ https://substack.com/redirect/dbd79263-d8a9-4f96-83d2-e15020a86759?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] score on its Coding Agent Index at less than half the cost per task.
That cost result lands directly in a market Anthropic has dominated for quite some time. By the end of 2025, Menlo Ventures estimated Anthropic held 54% of enterprise coding against OpenAI’s 21%, up from 42% six months earlier on the strength of Claude Code [ https://substack.com/redirect/333d5edc-8f5e-4d28-b88b-c50679b9298f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and coding is arguably the largest category of enterprise AI application spending.
With GPT-6, OpenAI now seems to be coming back for that lost market share, and the early demonstrations make it very clear.
Sharif Shameem, an engineer on OpenAI’s Labs team, posted a video of Astra completing all 48 levels of Neal Agarwal’s “I’m Not a Robot” browser game, a gauntlet that escalates from checkbox clicks to jigsaw puzzles and rhythm games.
The demo comes from inside OpenAI, so we should treat it accordingly. But the days of CAPTCHA might be over now…
Another developer shared a 3D anatomy explorer built with Astra. Its public repository [ https://substack.com/redirect/7e17b647-4041-4312-9266-0472bc81e0c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] documents 2,234 selectable meshes drawn from the BodyParts3D dataset, with search and controls to isolate anatomical structures.
Then there’s a reported benchmark milestone, too. GPT-6 Astra Pro & Fable 5.1 are now above the human baseline on SimpleBench. This benchmark was built around the everyday reasoning tasks humans were still better at.
As we can see, this gap has basically disappeared now,
